about: A desktop tool that lines up subtitles with the video they belong to.

prs.title: Batch mode pairs each episode with its own subtitle
prs.broken: When one subtitle was missing in a folder of episodes, each later episode was matched with the next episode's subtitle, then synced and saved.
prs.changed: Episode numbers in file names are no longer mistaken for language tags when pairing files.
prs.matters: A whole season no longer ends up with every subtitle on the wrong episode.

prs.title: Short WebVTT subtitles are no longer lost
prs.broken: Subtitle times without hours, which Whisper writes for videos under an hour, were skipped: shifting left them unmoved and converting to SRT gave an empty file.
prs.changed: These short times are now read, shifted and converted like full ones.
prs.matters: Subtitles made by Whisper sync and convert correctly.
